name: phase 2 spare parts demand forecast: evaluation set and pass marks

demand.source: fact_parts_order.quantity joined to dim_part on part_id
demand.series_start: each warehouse's first month with orders; no backfilling

origins.definition: origin = last training month T; forecast date = first day of month T+1; forecasts for months T+1 to T+6
origins.scored_in_period: an origin is scored in a period for a forecast length only if all its target months for that length lie in the period

gap.rule: E1: never a scored target month in either period

minimum_test_origins.below_minimum: reported apart with its scores and a forward forecast; never pooled into the pass mark

benchmarks.seasonal_naive: forecast for month m = actual of month m-12
benchmarks.moving_average: forecast = mean of the last w training months

methods.driver_model: Poisson generalised linear model, log link, one per warehouse and part family, on running hours and mean installed-base age, with an optional yearly season term

drivers.warehouse_blend: weighted by the warehouse's unit share per region over the origin's training months

running_hours.value: mean running hours per pump-day in the month, pumps with telemetry
running_hours.known_from: first day of the next month
running_hours.in_forecasts: forecast by the same month a year earlier (seasonal naive of the driver), known from the first day of month m-11

mean_age_years.value: mean age at month end of pumps installed on or before that date
mean_age_years.known_from: first day of the next month for months in training; the forecast date for forecast months
mean_age_years.in_forecasts: pumps in the register at the forecast date, aged forward; later installs are unknown

intervals.method: rolling backtest errors: at each origin, errors of earlier origins whose target months are on or before T, divided by their series' scale q, pooled over the warehouse's part families per horizon; 10th and 90th percentiles added to the forecast after multiplying by this series' q; lower bound floored at 0
intervals.too_few_errors: no interval, and the origin is not scored for coverage or Winkler

chosen_on_validation.criterion: lowest overall MASE of the 6-month forecast over validation origins; ties go to the simpler setting
chosen_on_validation.recorded_in: eval/forecast/split_lock.json, committed before the first test run

metrics.scale_q: mean of |y_t - y_(t-12)| over the origin's training months t with t-12 in the series
metrics.mase_series_origin: mean absolute error over the horizons of the forecast length, divided by q
metrics.mase_series: mean over the series' scored origins
metrics.mase_overall: mean over the warehouse's part family series
metrics.by_horizon: MASE per single horizon, reported for information
metrics.coverage: share of actuals inside the 80% interval, per origin and pooled over origins, series and horizons
metrics.winkler: upper - lower + (2 / 0.2) x (lower - actual) if actual < lower, + (2 / 0.2) x (actual - upper) if actual > upper; per origin and pooled, in units and divided by q
metrics.recheck: MASE recomputed by scripts/recheck_forecast.py from the saved forecasts and the raw tables, importing nothing from the forecast package

pass_marks.set_by: Reece, phase 2 prompt, 3 November 2026; never changed to pass (A9)
pass_marks.scope: test origins; warehouses meeting the minimum; judged for both the 3-month and the 6-month forecast
pass_marks.mase: driver model's overall MASE is below seasonal naive's and below the lowest overall MASE of naive, seasonal naive and moving average

coverage.of: driver model's 80% intervals, pooled over test origins, series and horizons
